# Pick transitions by pace

- Kind: `recipe`
- Category: `studio`
- Slug: `studio/transitions-by-pace`

## Summary

Darkroom recipe (basic). Most professional edits use straight cuts; transitions mark a change of time or place.

## Details

### When to use
The user asks for transitions or the cuts feel abrupt.
### What a pro does and why
Most professional edits use straight cuts; transitions mark a change of time or place. Cross dissolve (0.5 to 1 s) for calm time passing, dip to black for the end of a section, quick push or slide (0.3 s) for energetic social edits, wipes for retro or comic styles. Use one style per video.
### Ops
```json
{
  "summary": "Soft dissolve",
  "reason": "The pace is calm, so a soft dissolve fits better than a hard cut",
  "ops": [
    {"op": "set_transition", "clipId": "CLIP_ID", "type": "crossDissolve", "durationSeconds": 0.8}
  ]
}
```
Transitions sit on the incoming clip. Other choices: `dipToBlack` for a chapter end, `pushLeft` (0.3 s) for energy.
### How to adjust
Too slow: 0.4 s. Too flashy: replace pushes with cross dissolves. Many cuts: ask before adding a transition to every one.
